name: Ethnos 2nd edition & promo

rounds.endCondition: Each Age ends when the 3rd Dragon card is drawn; 3 Ages (2 Ages with 2-3 players)

categories.label: Parties played (all Ages)
categories.hint: Number of Parties by size, all Ages. 1 card=0, 2=1, 3=3, 4=6, 5=10, 6+=15. Rabbit Leader counts as +1 card; discarded Dogs do not count.

categories.label: Age 1 Region scoring
categories.hint: Token on space I of each Region you control (most Control markers). Tie: split, round down. Include Raccoon coins.

categories.label: Age 2 Region scoring
categories.hint: 1st: token II; 2nd: token I; ties split rounded down. 2-3 players: Age 2 is the last Age (2-player special rules).

categories.label: Age 3 Region scoring
categories.hint: 1st: token III; 2nd: II; 3rd: I; ties split rounded down. Only played with 4+ players.

categories.label: Bear Stonewards
categories.hint: +4 each time you take/move the Bear token, plus end-of-Age bonus printed on the token.

categories.label: Koi board
categories.hint: Prestige for top rank(s) on the Koi board at the end of each Age.

categories.label: Monkey migration
categories.hint: Prestige from emptying the Monkey Settlement board, by markers removed.

categories.label: Control markers on board (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Tiebreak only: total Control markers on the board.

categories.label: Largest Party in last Age (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Đội lớn nhất Kỷ cuối (phá hòa)
categories.hint: Tiebreak only: size of largest Party played in the last Age.

tiebreakers.description: Most Control markers on the board.
Largest Party played in the last Age, then second largest, and so on.

notes: family: area-majority. Verified vs official 2nd edition rulebook. Prestige is normally tracked live on the Prestige Track; categories reconcile it. Region token values are printed on components (vary per setup) so Region scoring is a scorer input per Age; Raccoon coins add to the Region token. Highest Prestige wins. 2-3 players play only 2 Ages; in 2-player games the Age 2 Region scoring differs (no 2nd place; sole controller gets both I and II tokens). Solo mode, Recruitment Mode and the Promo box (Platypus) not modelled; promo contents not checked against rulebook.
